text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky is training for the next race, the Osaka Hai, when Symboli Rudolf approaches her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After praising Maruzensky for setting a great example for the younger students, she expresses her genuine wish to compete with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When "Emperor" Symboli Rudolf asks to face her, Maruzensky is filled with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Symboli Rudolf enters the Osaka Hai to square off against Maruzensky.
